sources.name: Base Adresse Nationale
sources.description: The national address register: search as you type and reverse geocoding, with house-number precision. Read by packages/connectors/ban.

sources.name: API Découpage administratif
sources.description: Municipalities, departments and regions, with their codes and boundaries.

sources.name: Code officiel géographique (INSEE)
sources.description: The statistics office's official list of municipalities, departments and regions with their codes, published every year.

sources.name: Cadastre (PCI vecteur, Etalab)
sources.description: Parcels, building footprints and sections of the cadastre, by municipality, as GeoJSON.

sources.name: BD TOPO (IGN)
sources.description: The national topographic database: buildings with height and use, roads, land use, administrative limits.

sources.name: Référentiel National des Bâtiments
sources.description: One stable identifier per building, with its footprint and the addresses and parcels it links to.

sources.name: API Sirene (INSEE)
sources.description: The register of companies and establishments: SIREN, SIRET, legal form, activity, addresses.

sources.name: Enedis Open Data
sources.description: Aggregated consumption and production by municipality, grid capacities, energy sharing operations in service.

sources.name: Enedis Data Connect
sources.description: A customer's meter data (daily index, 30-minute load curve, contract) read by a third party with the customer's consent, per PRM. Kept for the consent's duration, never passed on.

sources.name: Open Data Réseaux Énergies
sources.description: Datasets of the French energy networks: generation, consumption, exchanges, operators' areas, energy communities.

sources.name: Enedis — activating and deactivating the collection of load curves
sources.description: The distribution operator's sheet on the collection of a meter's load curve: its step and history by meter size.

sources.name: ENTSO-E — list of Y EIC codes (areas)
sources.description: The list of area codes of the European electricity market, with their functions: bidding zone, control area, scheduling area.

sources.name: CRE — the energy transition in the non-interconnected zones
sources.description: The regulator's page on the zones not connected to the continental grid: Corsica, the overseas departments and islands.

sources.name: RTE — Bilan électrique 2024
sources.description: The transmission operator's yearly report on the French electricity system for 2024.
sources.license: Public data, reuse with attribution (RTE legal notice)

sources.name: RTE — Bilan électrique 2025
sources.description: The transmission operator's yearly report on the French electricity system for 2025.
sources.license: Public data, reuse with attribution (RTE legal notice)

sources.name: Eurostat — electricity prices components for household consumers, annual (nrg_pc_204_c)
sources.description: Yearly electricity prices of households by consumption band and component: energy and supply, network costs, taxes and levies, VAT.

sources.name: Eurostat — electricity prices components for non-household consumers, annual (nrg_pc_205_c)
sources.description: Yearly electricity prices of non-household consumers by consumption band and component.

sources.name: BOFiP — VAT rate on electricity and gas subscriptions (BOI-RES-TVA-000209)
sources.description: The tax administration's answer on the end of the reduced VAT rate on subscriptions of electricity and natural gas up to 36 kVA.

sources.name: CRE — questions and answers on peak and off-peak hours (6 February 2025)
sources.description: The regulator's answers on how off-peak hours are placed and on their reform under TURPE 7.

sources.name: Code du travail, article R. 4226-2 — voltage domains
sources.description: The article that defines the voltage domains of an electrical installation: very low, low and high voltage A and B.
